description.message: Share selected Chrome or Edge tabs with your paired Varin service.

interrupted.message: Service connection interrupted. Reconnect and share tabs again.

chooseTab.message: Choose a tab from this browser

setupHint.message: Create a pairing link in Varin → Settings → Browser. Allow access to that service when your browser asks.

shareHint.message: Share selected tabs for tasks to use, keeping your existing sign-in state.

controlHint.message: Pausing blocks new task input; an action already sent may still finish. DevTools can detach a tab. Closing this popup keeps tasks connected.

needsPairing.message: Connect to Varin with a device link first.

permissionDenied.message: Allow access to the selected Varin service to connect.

invalidLink.message: This device link is invalid or unsupported. Update the extension or create a new pairing link in Varin.

relayOnly.message: This link only offers a relay. Create a browser pairing link with a reachable service address.

pairRejected.message: The pairing link was rejected or expired. Create another link in Varin.

missingToken.message: The service did not return a device credential.
